blockers: Non-constant env quantifier transfer: ExistPart handles only constant-parent envs [y,t,t]. The Until/Since zones need [y,x,t] with x /= t. The formula must encode the full 2-var NF directly via a recursive construction by depth.

key_findings: nf_extend_fwd from depth-(K+2) 1-var gives depth-(K+1) 2-var. Depth drops prevent building full 3-var.
Pairwise 2-var composition fails: z from nf_extend at [y,x] has uncontrolled relationship to t.
ih_exist only handles Fin.cons y (fun _ => z) -- constant parent z. No combination covers [y,x,t].
The Eq zone proof works only because x=t makes the env constant.
A recursive formula construction by depth with increasing arity terminates because depth bottoms at 0.
